messages:
sara-cs: customer reports function call failing after we rolled a tool rename yesterday. they call `POST /v1/call` with tool name `send_email` and get back a 400: `{"error":"tool_not_found","tool":"send_email"}` :confused:

javier-support: any idea if this is a casing/alias issue? I remember the tool was renamed to `Send_Email` in the registry to match internal naming. customer was on a private deployment (vpc) so they could be hitting cached registry data.

kevin-eng: can you paste the exact request body? also which model/runtime?

sara-cs: payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "call": {
    "tool": "send_email",
    "args": {"to":"user@example.com","body":"hi"}
  }
}
```
error response: `{"status":400,"error":"tool_not_found","message":"tool 'send_email' not registered in customer registry"}`

kevin-eng: thanks. on the server side our lookup is supposed to be case-insensitive but the alias sync job recently changed to preserve incoming casing, so this smells like a registry sync + cache miss. ops-bot, can you show last registry-sync logs for that customer org id 0xA3?

ops-bot: fn-registry-sync job for org 0xA3 last run: 1793999000, status: completed, delta: 0. Note: last pushed changes by infra were at 1793992000 (rename Send_Email <- send_email). Cache TTL: 3600s.

javier-support: so their sync ran before the rename was pushed. but their call should still fallback to case-insensitive match right?

kevin-eng: it should. looking at the router logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] call_id=abc123 lookup_tool(org=0xA3, name=send_email) -> NOT_FOUND
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] fallback_casefold_lookup(name=send_email) -> NOT_FOUND
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] reply 400 tool_not_found
```
So fallback didn't run because an earlier change short-circuits when the registry record has a 'canonical_name' set and the cache hasn't been refreshed. Bug.

nina-ml: was the canonical_name field introduced as part of the schema change? that could explain the short-circuit if code expects exact match with canonical.

kevin-eng: yes schema v2 adds `canonical_name` and `aliases`. router v2 assumes canonical match if aliases list exists. the bug: when aliases array is empty (because registry snapshot pre-rename), router doesn't try casefolding. it should.

javier-support: quick repro we can ask the customer to try? or fix first then tell them to retry? they're blocked in prod (email sending).

kevin-eng: short term: force registry re-sync for that org and flush router cache. commands for ops (internal):
```
# trigger resync
./infra/runner trigger-registry-sync --org 0xA3 --force
# flush router cache
curl -X POST http://router-admin.local/cache/flush -d '{"org":"0xA3"}'
```

I can push a hotfix to router to try case-insensitive fallback before the full release.

javier-support: can you do the resync now? i will ask customer to standby.

ops-bot: enqueueing registry sync for org 0xA3. job id 9f2b. expected completion ~2m.

deploy-bot: registry-sync job 9f2b completed at 1794005668. changes applied: add alias `send_email` -> canonical `Send_Email`.

kevin-eng: ok now flush cache and test internal curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/call -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","call":{"tool":"send_email","args":{"to":"x@x.com","body":"hi"}}}'
# response: 200 ok (proxying to tool Send_Email)
```

javier-support: customer confirmed post-resync their calls succeed :tada: they had ~20 failed calls and now cleared. i'll close the escalation after 1 hour of monitoring.

kevin-eng: follow-up actions: 1) patch router to always try casefolding fallback when registry lookup fails (PR#4532). 2) add integration test covering rename+pre-sync client retry. 3) add monitoring alert when registry delta >0 but cache shows older snapshot for >TTL.

nina-ml: add note for private deploy docs: emphasize resync step and manual cache flush for air-gapped setups.

sara-cs: thanks team. i'll update the customer with the temporary mitigation steps and the fix ETA. :thumbsup:

javier-support: closing loop in 1hr if no regressions. :eyes:
